trigger: First touch/cross of either opening band during09:30 inclusive through09:45 exclusive. One event/date/threshold; both possible first directions retained if same-candle order is unknown.
reference: Open of the observed09:30 one-minute candle, America/New_York
return: After trigger, price touches or crosses the09:30 opening price in the opposite direction. Crossing by a gap counts; exact-price trade/limit fill is not established.
same_bar_order: Close at/beyond the opening price, a later opposite opening-band touch under a first-direction branch, or target-extreme after a trigger at that candle first print can prove a trigger-minute return. Other favorable extrema only make return possible. No fixed intrabar path.
sample: All fifteen observed09:30–09:44 minute bars, one instrument, valid finite tick-aligned OHLC. Exclude missing minutes without imputation.
limits: No stop loss or trading costs are applied. Return frequency is not a trading win rate.
The initial move need not be a monotonic trend.
2026 is partial YTD because available MNQ data endsSeptember3.
Ranges express within-minute ordering uncertainty, not statistical confidence intervals.
No selection optimization or extension of the fixed threshold grid.
First15-minute completeness excludes three March2020 disruption dates; preserve these exclusions.

amendment.change: Use only fixed09:45 ET deadline and first15-minute completeness. Remove1h/2h/full-session endpoints before scoring.

window: [09:30,09:45) America/New_York. Include only09:30 through09:44 minute bars; the09:45 candle is excluded.
status_at_freeze: No outcomes scored under either protocol version
